featured.subtitle: From the Last Queen collection
featured.title: Last Queen No.03
featured.body: For the woman who has been remade by what she's lived through — and returned to herself, softer and more her own.
featured.stoneBody: Hand-selected rainbow moonstone, chosen for its rare adularescence — a slow shift of silver-blue light that surfaces only at certain angles. Historically worn across cultures as a quiet companion through transformation: from one self into the next.
featured.materialBody: Hand-forged at our New Zealand studio, made one at a time. No two are truly alike — every Last Queen No.03 carries the small, deliberate signatures of the hands that shaped it.
featured.stylingBody: Worn alone against the collarbone in the morning, layered with finer chains for evening — not to perform, but to accompany. Left to rest on linen when not in wear.

about.title: Founded in 2019, on a quiet New Zealand shore.
about.p1: SIREN TEARS began in 2019 on the coast of New Zealand — the kind of shoreline where the light arrives slowly, the weather is something you read like a page, and a piece of jewelry can take all the time it needs.
about.p2: Every piece is hand-shaped. We work only with natural stones that arrive as themselves — preserved texture, original character, the quiet authority of something not made to be rushed.
about.p3: Six years on, our pieces are worn by a community of more than 10,000 women across more than thirty-five countries — women returning to themselves, keeping what matters, passing it on.

care.title: Care for Your Siren Tears
care.intro: Natural stones are resilient, but they are not indestructible. A little care keeps each piece close to how it was made.

water.title: Water
water.body: Avoid prolonged exposure to water. Remove your piece before swimming, bathing, or washing dishes.

perfume.title: Perfume
perfume.body: Apply perfume, lotion, and cosmetics before wearing your jewellery, not after.

storage.title: Storage
storage.body: Store your piece separately in a dry place, away from direct sunlight, to prevent scratching and preserve its colour.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.body: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth after wear. Avoid harsh chemicals, ultrasonic cleaners, and abrasive materials.

care.note: Some stones carry their own particular character and care needs — where relevant, we note this on the individual product page.

sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.triggerLabel: Not sure of your size? Measure here
sizeGuide.ringMethod1Title: Method 1 — measure a ring that already fits
sizeGuide.ringMethod1Body: Take a ring you already wear comfortably on the intended finger. Measure the inner diameter with a ruler, in millimetres, and match it to the table below.
sizeGuide.ringMethod2Body: Wrap a thin strip of paper or string snugly around the base of your finger. Mark where it overlaps, then measure that length in millimetres — this is your finger circumference.
sizeGuide.ringNote: If you're between two sizes, we recommend sizing up slightly for comfort. Fingers can also vary in size through the day — measuring in the evening, when fingers are slightly larger, tends to be more accurate.
sizeGuide.braceletMethodBody: Wrap a soft measuring tape (or a strip of string, then measure it against a ruler) snugly around your wrist, just below the wrist bone. For a comfortable, gently moving fit, add roughly 1–1.5cm to that measurement.
sizeGuide.braceletNote: Beaded pieces are generally worn slightly snugger than chain bracelets. If you prefer a looser, more relaxed drape, size up.
